# NORTH.md

> A markdown convention that declares a software project's purpose, ambition,
> and precomputed trade-off defaults in a form readable by both humans and AI coding agents.
> It is designed to give agents judgment when the prompt runs out.

## Specification

- [Specification v0.1](https://northfile.dev/spec): the seven sections, with rationale and examples.
- [Specification raw markdown](https://northfile.dev/spec.md): plain markdown, machine-readable.
- [Spanish Specification](https://northfile.dev/es/spec): versión en español de la especificación.
- [Spanish raw markdown](https://northfile.dev/es/spec.md): especificación en markdown plano en español.
- [Full LLM dump](https://northfile.dev/llms-full.txt): full specification text inlined for LLM consumption.
- [Comparison](https://northfile.dev/compare): how NORTH.md relates to AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, SOUL.md, VISION.md, and CONSTITUTION.md.

## Reference

- [README](https://github.com/berthelius/north): repository introduction.
- [Examples](https://northfile.dev/examples): one real NORTH.md (this site's own) and five illustrative ones (SaaS, OSS library, agency, side project, internal platform).
- [Why](https://northfile.dev/why): why projects benefit from an explicit statement of direction.
- [FAQ](https://northfile.dev/faq): common questions.
- [Changelog](https://northfile.dev/changelog): specification version history.

## Machine-readable endpoints

- [Spec v0.1 (JSON)](https://northfile.dev/api/spec/v0.1.json): JSON representation of the v0.1 spec.
- [Spec v0.1 (markdown)](https://northfile.dev/api/spec/v0.1.md): raw markdown specification (v0.1).
- [LLM index (JSON)](https://northfile.dev/.well-known/llms.json): machine-readable pointer file for LLM agents discovering the spec.

## Related conventions

The layer numbers refer to the five-layer model NORTH.md proposes; it is a model, not an established standard.

- [CONSTITUTION.md](https://agentconstitution.dev): project-level principles and boundaries for coding agents (Layer 1, limits).
- [AGENTS.md](https://agents.md): operational instructions for coding agents (Layer 2, how).
- [DESIGN.md](https://github.com/google-labs-code/design.md): design tokens and rationale for coding agents, from Google Labs (Layer 3, look).
- [SOUL.md](https://soul.md): the agent's persona, values, and tone (Layer 4, who).
- [NORTH.md](https://northfile.dev): project purpose, ambition, and trade-off defaults (Layer 5, direction).
- [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org): the convention this file follows, for helping LLMs use a website.
